Placement needs traced ground under the crosshair — a floorless tile silently fails.
These act on whatever the crosshair is pointing at.
Hide/Reset change real server fog state. The minimap pair is local display only.
SetTimeCheat takes seconds into the cycle; the events flag replays day-section transitions.
